name: Giant Ape
otherStatistics: Athletics +9 and Perception +4. Passive Perception 14. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A huge gorilla-like ape with silver-grey back fur, a heavy brow, and long muscular forearms that end in broad knuckles.

sections.Printed source: D&D Basic Rules, v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 130.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit against one target within 10 ft. On a hit, deal 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit against one target, range 50/100 ft. On a hit, deal 30 (7d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Choose Rock as its own action. At distances beyond 50 ft. and up to 100 ft., roll it with disadvantage for long range.

name: Giant Badger
otherStatistics: Darkvision 30 ft. and passive Perception 11. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A stocky giant badger with a black-and-white striped face, grizzled grey fur, broad shoulders, and long ivory digging claws.

sections.Printed source: D&D Basic Rules, v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 130.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. Roll Wisdom (Perception) checks with advantage when they depend on scent.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit against one target within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit against one target within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage.

name: Giant Bat
otherStatistics: Blindsight 60 ft. and passive Perception 11. No listed skills or languages.

Keen Hearing. Roll Wisdom (Perception) checks with advantage when they depend on hearing.
